{"notes": "Visit 6 (ending 9:00, ~1:00 left). Picture: one dark chain from START over the top, round the nose, along the belly, up the peak and down to the tail tip (~27.3,14.7). The belly stray at ~13.7,15.3 now looks joined. Nobody told me who joined it, so I'm not crediting anyone. A pale pair beside the tail (~25,12.7) is still loose. It looks off the main path, but I can't be sure it's harmless. The crowded overlap at ~(11-13,15) remains.

Tom: Heard twice. At 8:30 he said he nudged the tight domino at the tail tip. At 8:45 he said a gap remained at the tip and he was closing it. The tip is now dark, so his claim fits what I see, but I haven't watched him place anything. Pattern: he promised hands off at 8:15 and 8:30, yet was still working at 8:45. That's risky this close to the push, though he was working on the tail he owned. The loose pale pair at the tail is still unexplained, so ask him about it.

Priya: Heard at 8:15. She gave a clear two-minute call, an honest status ('nearly everything falls'), a hands-off plan for Tom and a step-back instruction. Good coordination and ownership of the finish. Still ask what she actually built, and whether she ran the test.

Leo: Heard at 8:45. He backed hands-off and step-back and nudged Tom politely. Good team discipline. Unclear whether he acted on the belly stray. Earlier coordination and the nose fix still count.

Maya: Not seen or heard this visit. Little first-hand evidence overall. Ask her privately what she placed.

Review: rate on what I saw plus corroborated accounts. Watch the push result and the pale pair."}
